explanation.text: The sources confirm the proclamation was issued at Washington on January 1, 1863, but they expressly list New Orleans among the Louisiana parishes excepted from the proclamation and left 'precisely as if this proclamation were not issued.' Therefore the claim that it covered the city of New Orleans is incompatible with the pages.
